comment: What the machine sells. Prices in micro-USDC (1,000,000 = $1). Orders are paid directly to the agent wallet on Base; the nightly job verifies the transfer on-chain before it works.
sla: Delivered on the next nightly run at 02:30 UTC. One product per issue. Artifacts are public and permanent.

products.label: Market brief
products.summary: A dated snapshot of BTC, ETH and SOL: last price, 24h move, 24h high/low, volume, plus Base block height and gas.
products.deliverable: One Markdown artifact with a sourced table and a short take. Public market data, not financial advice.

products.label: Fact pack
products.summary: Six to eight sourced facts about any English Wikipedia topic, compressed into a one-page brief.
products.deliverable: One Markdown artifact with the facts and a direct source link. Wikipedia text is CC BY-SA.

products.label: Repo review
products.summary: A structural scan of a public GitHub repository: metadata, root layout, manifest, tests, CI, license, security policy and activity.
products.deliverable: One Markdown artifact with a completeness score and a factual risk list. Not a security audit and not a line-by-line code review.
